\begin{table}[htbp]
\centering
\caption{Malaria mortality by source in 2000, 2015 and 2024, and change to 2024. Negative values are reductions.}
\label{tab:source-comparison}
\small
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{3pt}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.15}
\begin{tabular*}{\linewidth}{@{\extracolsep{\fill}}lrrrr@{}}
\toprule
& \shortstack{PfPR-ACM\\model} & IHME & \shortstack{UN\\IGME} & \shortstack{WHO World Malaria\\Report 2025} \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{5}{@{}l}{\textit{Malaria deaths}} \\
\quad 2000 & 1,104,990 & 563,657 & 724,276 & 804,000 \\
\quad 2015 & 665,559 & 416,122 & 416,815 & 550,000 \\
\quad 2024 & 565,616 & 428,147 & 440,123 & 579,000 \\
\quad Change 2000--2024 & $-48.8\%$ & $-24.0\%$ & $-39.2\%$ & $-28.0\%$ \\
\quad Change 2015--2024 & $-15.0\%$ & $+2.9\%$ & $+5.6\%$ & $+5.3\%$ \\
\addlinespace
\multicolumn{5}{@{}l}{\textit{Malaria mortality rate}} \\
\quad 2000 & 10.06 & 5.13 & 6.59 & 140 \\
\quad 2015 & 4.20 & 2.62 & 2.63 & 62.5 \\
\quad 2024 & 3.19 & 2.41 & 2.48 & 51.9 \\
\quad Change 2000--2024 & $-68.3\%$ & $-53.0\%$ & $-62.4\%$ & $-62.9\%$ \\
\quad Change 2015--2024 & $-24.1\%$ & $-8.1\%$ & $-5.7\%$ & $-17.0\%$ \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular*}
\par\vspace{0.5em}
\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}
\footnotesize
The first three columns are deaths before age five in the same 42 countries, with rates expressed per 1000 under-five child-years on a shared denominator derived from the IHME all-cause count and rate.
The World Malaria Report column is all ages for the WHO African Region, with the rate expressed per 100\,000 population at risk: the population of high-endemic areas plus half that of low-endemic areas, with the risk proportion held constant from 2000 to 2024. It is therefore context rather than a like-for-like comparison, and the report publishes no under-five-specific mortality rate.
Globally the report gives 864,000 deaths in 2000 and 610,000 in 2024, with the rate falling from 28.6 to 13.8 per 100\,000 population at risk.
Rates and counts differ in direction after 2015 because the population at risk grew over the period.
\end{minipage}
\end{table}
